data.credibility: Management guides transparently with measurable targets like FY27 volume and capex, maintaining pending status as these horizons have not yet arrived. Historical consistency suggests reliable reporting without quiet revisions.

lines.line: Targeting over 10 percent volume growth for FY27; status is currently pending.
Planning INR 14,000 crores capex for FY27; status remains pending.

bull: Revenue compounded at 21.1 percent and net profit at 27.3 percent annually over five years.
Operating cash flow reached 118 percent of reported profit over five years, turning profits into cash.
Debt-to-equity is 0.0 with borrowings reduced to INR 83 crores against net worth of INR 109,002 crores.
bear: Growth is slowing down to 15.7 percent annually over three years compared to 21.1 percent over five years.
Working-capital days stretched from minus 50 to minus 29 over the five-year period.
Valuation stands at a P/E of 32.8 with an EBITDA margin of 10.0 percent on a TTM basis.
